input.query: WITH w AS (SELECT date_trunc('week',decision_date)::DATE AS week_start,sum(n_approved)::DOUBLE/sum(n_decisions) AS rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform='ios' AND doc_type='driving_licence' GROUP BY 1) SELECT avg(rate) baseline_weekly_mean,stddev_samp(rate) baseline_weekly_sd,min(rate) baseline_weekly_min,max(rate) baseline_weekly_max FROM w WHERE week_start >= DATE '2026-01-05' AND week_start < DATE '2026-04-13'
